page.layout: One printed page: running head at top; main text in one column; marginal notes in the left margin, beside the first and third paragraphs. No notes on the right.

main_text.p: At hic modus exemplaris non dum sufficit. Probatur, 1,Hæc ita quidem esse debere prolixè largior; sed modum hunc exemplarem servandi, vel cum primo sufficientem, vel præcipuum esse, inficior.

I. Si enim illi, qui nobis imitandi proponuntur, sunt servatores, certè Sancti homines quoq; dicentur Servatores. Nam & Sanctorum hominum exempla nobis imitanda proponit Sacra Scriptura, 1. Corinth. 11. Paulus ait:

p.i: Imitatores mei estote, sicut ego Christi, 1. Thes. 1. v. 6. Et vos imitatores nostri facti fuistis, & Domini, recepto sermone cum oppressione multa, cum gaudio Spiritus S. adeo, ut fueritis exemplaria omnibus credentibus in Macedonia & Achaia. Philip. 3. v. 17. Estote simul imitatores mei, fratres, & eos considerate, qui ita incedunt, sicut habetis nos pro exemplari. Hebr. 13. v. 8. Memores estote ducum vestrorum, qui locuti sunt vobis sermonem Dei; quorum imitamini fidem, considerantes, qui fuerit exitus conversationis ipsorum.

main_text.p: Probatio secunda.II. Si Christus sic nobis vitæ suæ exemplo viam salutis ostendit, ut imitatione ejus vitam nostram componentes, ad salutem adspiremus, frustra nobis videri queat æternæ Salutis via o-stensa,

page.notes: The last line is cut off at the foot of the page and continues on the next page; "o-stensa," is read from the hyphenated line end and the fragment "ftensa,", with the long s printed as plain s. The note "Probatio secunda." is placed at the start of paragraph II. The printed "Thef." is read as "Thes." (long s as s), and "1ȝ" as 13. No doubtful readings otherwise.
